verdict.rationale: Termius is a terminal and SSH client with a built-in SFTP file manager. Some terminal and file-management tools ship rendered-file previews, so this axis is a fair question for the category. The evidence shows SFTP file management (dual-pane, terminal-to-SFTP switching) but nothing about rendering Markdown or HTML, nor any live-reload preview.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview Markdown, HTML, and other rendered files with live reload
